أبتذل (form VIII)
# أَبْتَذِلُ (ʔabtaḏilu) /ʔab.ta.ði.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# أُبْتَذَلُ (ʔubtaḏalu) /ʔub.ta.ða.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# أَبْتَذِلَ (ʔabtaḏila) /ʔab.ta.ði.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# أُبْتَذَلَ (ʔubtaḏala) /ʔub.ta.ða
